subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Vocabulary of advertising and evaluating adverts
outcomes: Describe and evaluate an advert with reasons

tf.s: 'Nutritious' is a good adjective for a mobile phone.
tf.why: Nutritious describes food that is good for your health.

tf.s: 'Copy' in advertising means the words in an advert.
tf.why: Copy is the text of the ad.

tf.s: A hard-sell technique emphasises the features of a product.
tf.why: It shows what the product can do.

tf.s: A soft-sell technique focuses on how a product makes consumers feel.
A washing machine ad that lists what the machine can do uses soft-sell.
A misleading advert gives a false impression.
tf.why: It makes you believe something untrue.

tf.s: An advert can be irritating because it is repetitive or boring.
tf.why: Repeating the same thing annoys viewers.

tf.s: Adjectives in adverts are not important for persuading people.
An advert must get its message across slowly.
tf.why: An ad must get its message across quickly.

boxes.q: Which adjective suits a cold drink?

boxes.why: Nutritious food is good for you.

boxes.q: Which adjective suits an expensive hotel?
boxes.why: Luxurious means very comfortable and expensive.
Long-lasting means it works for a long time.
Soft-sell shows how the product makes you feel.
Hard-sell shows what the product can do.

boxes.q: Why can an ad be irritating?
Which word describes an ad that gives a false impression?
boxes.why: Misleading ads make us believe untrue things.

mcq.q: What part of speech are words like 'stylish' and 'nutritious'?

mcq.why: Copy means the text of an ad.

mcq.q: What does a soft-sell technique focus on?
o: how a product makes consumers feel

mcq.q: Which technique is used in a washing machine ad that shows what the machine can do?
Which two adjectives suit chocolate best?
mcq.why: Chocolate is described by its taste.

mcq.q: Complete: These trainers are comfortable and ______.
mcq.why: Good trainers last a long time.

mcq.q: Which is an example of an advert that gives a false impression?
o: A car ad suggesting your life will become more exciting if you buy the car
mcq.why: It promises something the car cannot really give.

mcq.q: Why can a shampoo advert be misleading?
o: It may suggest the shampoo will make you as beautiful as the girl in the ad
mcq.why: Shampoo cannot change how beautiful you are.

mcq.q: Why do many ads combine hard-sell and soft-sell?
o: They show features and also how the product makes you feel
mcq.why: A car ad can show design and the feeling of driving.

mcq.q: Why are adjectives important in advertisements?
o: They describe features and make the product sound attractive
